title: Orsen and the Static Revisited
author: Quentin Sterling
blurb: Casper Amberdale, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
